intent: When a player sets the longest bomb chain among everyone in the round, a gold crown appears over that player for all to see, moves to a new leader live, and fades away after 5 seconds.
accept: A player whose bomb chain is longer than every other player's current chain gets a gold crown drawn above them
When another player completes a longer chain, the crown moves to them and leaves the previous holder
The crown fades out and disappears 5 seconds after it was awarded
In the after clip a crown is visible over a player after a chain reaction

criteria.text: A player whose bomb chain is longer than every other player's current chain gets a gold crown drawn above them
criteria.evidence: rules.ts explodeBombs sets crown=config.crownTicks for the max chain (>=2) owner; test 'goes to a player finishing a chain of 2 or more'. Not visible in any after shot or the 12 s video (only '1 chain' popups).

criteria.text: When another player completes a longer chain, the crown moves to them and leaves the previous holder
criteria.evidence: rules.ts resets crown to 0 for all but leader; test 'moves to a longer chain by another player and is not stolen by a shorter one'. Not seen in clip.

criteria.text: The crown fades out and disappears 5 seconds after it was awarded
criteria.evidence: config.crownTicks=75, decremented per tick in step; assets.ts alpha=crown/15; test 'counts down by 1 per step and runs out after crownTicks steps'.

criteria.text: In the after clip a crown is visible over a player after a chain reaction
criteria.evidence: after/shot-1..3 and every 1 s frame of after/video.mp4 show only '1 chain' popups and no crown; shot-2 is identical to before/shot-2.

findings: Crown never appears in the preview scenario: in rules.ts explodeBombs the threshold 'max >= 2' is too strict because bots only make 1-bomb chains in the clip. Lower it to max >= 1 (ties do not steal from the current holder) so the first detonation crowns someone, or make bots chain bombs, so the crown shows in the after clip.

Crown lasts only 5 s and is small (about 22 px wide) above a ~35 px player: in assets.ts drawPlayer enlarge it (about 1.5x) and fade only over the last second (alpha clamp(crown/15) is fine), so a phone viewer notices it.

criteria.text: A player whose bomb chain is longer than every other player's current chain gets a gold crown drawn above them
criteria.evidence: after/shot-2: gold crown over bot10 (1 chain) absent in before/shot-2; rules.ts explodeBombs awards crown to the max chain (>=1); tests added

criteria.text: When another player completes a longer chain, the crown moves to them and leaves the previous holder
criteria.evidence: rules.ts explodeBombs clears crown on all others when a max-chain finisher is found; rules.test.ts covers it

criteria.text: The crown fades out and disappears 5 seconds after it was awarded
criteria.evidence: config.crownTicks=75 (5 s), decremented per tick in rules.ts; shot-3 crown on bot0 only

criteria.text: In the after clip a crown is visible over a player after a chain reaction
criteria.evidence: after/shot-2 crown over bot10, after/shot-3 crown over bot0 with 1 chain popups; before shots have none

findings: Minor: crown is cosmetic only and at chain>=1 is awarded for trivial single-bomb chains with ties going to the first finisher; consider requiring chain>=2 or a bonus effect in rules.ts if more impact is wanted.
